subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled session-memory filenames and `# Session` headers switch from host-local/TZ time to `agents.defaults.userTimezone` when configured?
rationale: Current docs and shipped behavior say session-memory uses host local dates, while the issue asks to extend the user-timezone contract to persisted memory artifacts, which can change artifact filenames during upgrade.

options.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
options.body: Use the existing configured-timezone resolver for session-memory filenames, fallback slugs, and headers, with focused tests and docs, and avoid adding a new config key.

options.title: Keep host-local session-memory
options.body: Leave the shipped host-local behavior in place and document that `userTimezone` only affects prompt context and configured auto-flush paths.

options.title: Design a dedicated memory timezone knob
options.body: Add explicit product/API discussion before introducing a new memory-specific timezone setting because OpenClaw already has a large config surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
recommendation.body: Use the existing configured-timezone resolver for session-memory filenames, fallback slugs, and headers, with focused tests and docs, and avoid adding a new config key.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged the current session-memory timezone behavior and is the clearest current-history owner for the shipped artifact contract.
